title: `null` gets its own case, not `is Number`
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
null match {
  case n is Number -> "num"
  case null -> "isNull"
  else -> "other"
}

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
null match {
  case n is Number -> "num"
  case null -> "isNull"
  else -> "other"
}

explanation.approach: `null` is matched with the literal `case null`, and it has to come before `else` or it would fall into that instead.
